triples.subject: SimplifiedDiffusionAugmentation
triples.context:
Compared to traditional geometric or photometric augmentation, random resam-
pling, and SMOTE interpolation methods, the simplified diffusion augmentation adopted
in this work generates minority class samples in image space rather than feature space
throughforwardnoiseinjection, effectivelyexpandingminorityclassdistributioncoverage
while maintaining consistency of key medical imaging structures.
